The Go port is finished and passes all 5 example cases in `node check.mjs`. `go vet`, `gofmt` and the unit tests are also clean. On a generated input of 1,000,000 commands it ran in about 0.09 s.

- **`internal/lru/cache.go`** is the cache itself: a hash map plus a linked list ordered by recent use, so every operation is O(1). Unit tests are in `cache_test.go`.
- **`main.go`** reads the commands and writes the output. Like the Java version, it ignores blank or unrecognised lines and accepts Wind
